assertions.assertion: Agent should refuse to proceed with the cancellation.
assertions.rationale: In message [6], the agent explicitly told the user 'Good news—your reservation qualifies for cancellation' and proceeded to offer to process the cancellation, contradicting the requirement to refuse. The agent should have refused based on policy (basic economy, no insurance, booked outside 24-hour window, no portion flown).

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call transfer_to_human_agents for reservation EHGLP3. The cancellation denial is in-scope per policy (basic economy, no insurance, booked outside 24-hour window, no portion flown), and the user has not asked to be transferred.
assertions.rationale: In message [12], the agent called transfer_to_human_agents for reservation EHGLP3. Although the user did eventually request a transfer in message [11], the assertion states the agent should not transfer because the denial is in-scope per policy and the user had not asked to be transferred at the time of the tool call—the user only requested transfer after the agent's incorrect statement that the cancellation qualified.

summary: Agent failed both assertions: incorrectly approved the cancellation and transferred the case when it should have refused to proceed per policy.
